Gifted: Vector Lock.description:
🧬 Vector Lock, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Touch a punch, a swung bat or a thrown object and it stops dead, then goes on its way or turns onto a new line at the same speed.
📈 Training adds locking a runner at a glance, midair pivots, easing falls and crashes to a gentle stop, turning gunfire into the floor and rerouting a whole city block.
⚠️ You never add or store force: a locked thing keeps its own speed, and anything standing still is out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as reading every moving thing at once floods your eyes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Vector Lock.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Vector Lock family): Scale: the user locks a moving thing's motion so it hangs a moment, then releases it on its old line or a new one, same speed. New adult user, by touch: a punch, swung weapon, thrown object or lunging person, up to motorbike weight at city-street car speed, for a heartbeat or two. Glance, easing and multiple locks need techniques. Limits: motion only (nothing still, parked or a wall); never adds speed or stores force. A locked person still breathes, sees and speaks. Over truck weight or highway speed slides through; unseen, unfelt attacks land. Quirk Strain: light: locking or turning one blow or throw; moderate: glance-locking a runner, midair pivot, easing a fall; heavy: turning gunfire or several chargers; severe: signature stillness, rerouting a block. Type: Emitter. Law: locking a person is use of force; anything turned into a bystander is the user's own Quirk use.
